description: This PHP file defines a migration class used to modify the database schema and localization strings for the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically for version 5.1.0. It includes methods for updating tables, inserting permissions, managing workflow states, updating language strings, and configuring menus across different modules.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class extending AbstractMigration to handle database schema and localization updates for OrangeHRM version 5.1.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration script, updating database tables, permissions, language strings, module configurations, workflow states, and menu items.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version of the migration (5.1.0).

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LangStringHelper.

methods.name: getTranslationHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of TranslationHelper.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the language string version to the specified version.

methods.name: addValidColumnToRequestResetPassword
methods.description: Adds a boolean 'expired' column to the 'ohrm_reset_password' table.

methods.name: insertModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Inserts default page configurations for a module and user role.

methods.name: insertWorkflowState
methods.description: Inserts a workflow state into the workflow state machine table.

methods.name: insertReviewWorkflowStates
methods.description: Inserts predefined workflow states for review processes.

methods.name: insertSelfReviewWorkflowStates
methods.description: Inserts predefined workflow states for self-review processes.

methods.name: insertReviewListScreenForAdminRole
methods.description: Inserts access permissions for the review list screen for Admin role.

methods.name: modifyThemeTable
methods.description: Modifies the 'ohrm_theme' table by dropping, adding, and changing columns related to theme customization.

methods.name: modifyTrackerLogsUserForeignKey
methods.description: Updates foreign key constraints on 'ohrm_performance_tracker_log' table.

methods.name: modifyEmployeeTrackerScreenRolePermission
methods.description: Adjusts user role permissions for the employee performance tracker screen.

methods.name: updateMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Helper to update menu configurator classes for specific modules and screens.

methods.name: updateRecruitmentMenuItems
methods.description: Updates menu configurators for recruitment-related menu items.

methods.name: updatePerformanceMenuItems
methods.description: Updates menu configurators for performance-related menu items.
